business_problem: Onetera needed to help more than 90 municipalities turn fragmented regulations, zoning maps, permit rules, and legacy documents into fast resident-facing services without imposing heavy IT overhead or expensive manual processing on city partners.
solution_summary: Onetera built its Government Intelligence Agent as a local-inference stack for municipal data using NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition GPUs and NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM. The platform preprocesses unstructured public data from PDFs, city websites, county databases, and other records on premises so it can serve reliable conversational experiences at runtime. Onetera combines open models such as GPT OSS 20B and Llama 4 with LangGraph-driven agent flows, where each agent has defined goals, tool-calling paths, and access to quality-controlled context. For more complex workflows, including permit agents and spatial-AI use cases, the system chains multiple capabilities while keeping humans in the loop for validation. This architecture gives Onetera a reusable municipal AI foundation that can launch new city programs quickly while controlling cost and maintaining legal accuracy.

data_flow: Municipal data from PDFs, websites, county databases, zoning maps, and permit logs is preprocessed locally on RTX PRO systems, LangGraph routes tasks through the Government Intelligence Agent and open models such as GPT OSS 20B or Llama 4, and the resulting structured guidance is returned through resident and staff service experiences.
business_outcome: Onetera reduced end-to-end municipal program processing time by about 40 percent, cut per-run costs by 88 percent, increased throughput 1.7x, supported dozens of municipalities simultaneously, and shortened program launches from months to days for services such as permits and business guides.
metrics: Programs that once took months to launch can now be deployed in days
architecture_clues: Onetera primarily uses local inference for preprocessing unstructured public data before runtime interactions.
The platform keeps a human in the loop during validation phases for legal and service accuracy.
LangGraph defines conditional agent logic and tool-calling across workflows such as permit assistance and business service guides.
evidence_quotes: Onetera's Government Intelligence Agent, which provides AI-powered support for accessing critical government services, streamlines complex processes, accelerates inference, and enables rapid deployment of critical programs at scale.
By preprocessing scattered municipal data (across PDFs, city websites, county databases, etc.), Onetera can more efficiently and reliably serve conversational AI experiences at runtime.
Onetera's local inference server uses a variety of open-source models for different tasks, such as GPT OSS 20B and Llama 4.
For the Business Service Guide and related government use cases, Onetera uses LangGraph as its framework to define agent flow and tool-calling.
Programs that once took months to launch can now be deployed in days.
